hits.s: m, washed down w/1500 lpm and tagged bottom. Circulated 15 minutes on bottom before dropping ball and circulated same down. Started coring the first 17m w/high ROP, 60m/hrs. After 20,5m, lost torque and ROP, pulled off bottom. No overpull. Pulled up to casing shoe and circulated bottom up. POOH. 20,3 meter cored, 99 % recovery.
